visualCharacteristics.purpose: Date / meta line of a single blog post, event or news item; also lays out the following default-content article body as a centred column
visualCharacteristics.layout: Blue bold date with calendar icon above a centred 8/12 article column

contentPattern.structure: one row, one cell: the date (e.g. "January 15, 2024"); extra paragraphs become further meta lines. Article body is default content after the block in the same section

usage: Date line at the top of blog, event and news detail pages; use variant event on event posts.
reuseGuidance: Reuse article for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
